description: The machine-checkable half of docs/__meta__/arch.md: the frontmatter every document in docs/arch/ carries, one H1 title first, no empty section, and References closing the document. It is the base layer; a namespace layer per document kind is applied on its own beside it and can only add to it. No section has a word cap and the file has no token budget.

name.description: <kind>-<NNN>-<slug>: the document's kind, a three-digit number from one sequence shared by every document in docs/arch/, then the subject in a few kebab-case words. See docs/__meta__/arch.md#2-naming.

description.description: One sentence: what the document decides or requires.

type.description: The document's kind, equal to the filename's prefix.

status.description: Where the document stands; the kind's namespace specification states the vocabulary.

outline.description: The issues and documents the document comes from, builds on or leads to, each with its relation.
